content: Galana ꞌana heꞌita

Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Tomota tupwadi nata ꞌebetoho baibaiwana sipaihowadi ꞌoimiya ma ꞌabehega siꞌabi hebeꞌugomi, ma ꞌeguma taiyawedi taudi ꞌebetohowedi sipaihowediya tuwa ꞌatemuyamuyaidi.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya toꞌabi hebeꞌuina, ꞌilobwaineya ma daꞌule madouna silosipwa ꞌaniꞌona ma niꞌu dubaduba siulasuluhe, ma ꞌoinega sahena gwagwama siheheꞌauꞌaunaowe.
Nuwasam weyahina
“Coinega waꞌitayahigomi, ma ꞌeguma tasiu ꞌoiuwa ꞌipaihowa galagala, ꞌuhegwae ꞌina puiina, ma ꞌeguma ꞌinuwabui ꞌunuwasam.
Ma ꞌeguma tasiu ꞌina sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌoina ta masebeni ꞌipaihowa galagala ꞌoiuwa, ma tuta ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoina ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi ꞌoiuwa sabi nuwasam, ꞌilobwainegowa ma mabwaiyana ꞌunuwasamudi.”
Hemisa weyahina
Eeta Yesu ꞌana tohepwailaowedi sigwaeya, sigwae, “Cima hemisa ꞌuꞌabihewaiwai.”
Ma badaina ꞌigwaeya, “Ceguma ꞌimi hemisa ꞌana waiwai gide seyala patuna, sowasowahina ma ꞌaiwe bewa madouna ꞌoina wagwae, ‘Cudabugo ma niꞌuwa ꞌuboi ꞌuꞌumago,’ nata ꞌimi gwaeina ꞌihematamatane.”
Topaihowao ꞌidi paihowa

Ma wete ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Ceguma ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌowa ma ꞌino hewali, tauna togesoha bo nuwana hebai ꞌana toꞌitayahina, ma tutaina ꞌeguma hewaliina ꞌina paihowega ꞌilatuma, geya sowasowahina ma ꞌuloina ꞌabehega tauna ꞌiꞌai nugeta,
ma hesi ꞌugwae, ‘Cagu ꞌuꞌatububu ma ꞌuꞌitayahigau ma yaꞌai, ma ꞌoinega ꞌowa muliyetega ꞌuꞌai ma ꞌunuma.’
Coinega hewaliina ꞌina paihowa weyahina ꞌana loyauwedo geya ꞌida lobeya ꞌina bada ꞌoinega, weyahina tauna tuwa ꞌina paihowa.

Ma ꞌomi wete gidemusa, ꞌeguma tutaina ginaula mabwaiyana wapaihowadi, toꞌaha gide yaloinegomiya, wagwae, ‘Cehe, tauma tuwa topaihowa, ꞌoinega toꞌaha gidemusa ꞌama loinaina gide ꞌapaihoweya, beno gide ꞌama lobwaina moisa.’”
Tolepelo nima luwaluwa ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Ma Yesu Yelusalema weyahina ꞌitautauya ma Sameliya ta Galili gamwagamwanidiya ꞌilatulatu.
Ta ꞌaigeda ꞌasa ꞌoina ꞌinaoma ma tolepelo nima luwaluwa ꞌilobediya, eema ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌoinega siha hila,
ma sibwaubwau ꞌenadi madounega, sigwaeya, “Bada Yesu ꞌuꞌatemuyamuyaemai.”
Coinega ꞌiloꞌitahila ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Watauya ma topwaoli ꞌoidiya waheꞌitaegomi.” Ma sitautauya ꞌedai ta ꞌadi lepelo ꞌigumwala,
ma ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌoidiyega, tauna gwama Sameliya, ꞌiꞌiteya ꞌabehega ꞌibwebweꞌana pwaiya, ꞌoinega ꞌihila ma ꞌenana madounega Yehoba ꞌihepwatuweya,
ma Yesu ꞌahena ꞌibeꞌu talutalubuꞌiya ma ꞌoina ꞌiloyauwedowa.
Coinega Yesu loheyaina ꞌihegwaeya, “Nige wate nima luwaluwa yaꞌabihe bwebweꞌanegomiya, ma taꞌeha site naeniyedi?
Togidega geya sihilama ma Yehoba ꞌoina siloyauwedo? Ma ꞌowa taumana geya Yudiya ꞌoinega, ma ꞌunaoma sabi loyauwedo.
Coinega ꞌino hemisega ꞌabihetena ꞌulobeya. Causala, ꞌutoholo ma ꞌutau.”
Yehoba ꞌina loina tuta ꞌinaonaoma weyahina

Palisiyao tupwadi sinaoma ma Yesu sihesilaleya to tuta gide ꞌoina Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌilatuma. Coinega Yesu ꞌidi hesilalaina ꞌihemaiseya bewa gidemusa, ꞌigwaeya, “Geya sowasowahina ma tomota matadiya Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌinaonaoma siꞌita.
Ma wete geya sowasowahidi ma sigwae, ‘Waꞌita Bewa’, bo nuwana ‘Nage’, weyahina Yehoba ꞌina loina ꞌoimiya ꞌimiya pwaiya.”

Coinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Cabwa yaꞌebesinegomi, ma muliyetega nuwanuwami madouna ma taugu Loheyaiguina baꞌidamiu tada miyamiya sabwelo ꞌaigeda tuwa weyahina, ma hesi nata geya waꞌiteꞌitegau.
Ma ꞌeguma tomota sigwae, ‘Keliso nage’, bo nuwana ‘Bewa’, nata sahena wamulimuliyedi.
Weyahina saugaina ꞌeguma yanaonaoma, galewa ꞌana ꞌita gide ꞌasilala daisinamo, gide namala madouna ꞌana ꞌita.
“Ta muliyetega ma ginauledi sihapwesa, nugeta mehau bewa silogwahategau, ma ꞌoidiyega muya yaloba.
“Cigu hilama ꞌana tuta Nowa ꞌina tuta gidemusa.

Weyahina Nowa ꞌina tuta siꞌaiꞌai ma sinumanuma ma wete loheloheyadi ta wahiwahinedi sihaihai ꞌana siga Nowa ꞌina waga ꞌigeluwa, ta yagewa ꞌilatuwa ta ꞌoinega tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌimutudiya. Ma taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌigu hilama gidemusa.
“Ma wete Lota ꞌina tuta gide, saugaina tomota mabwaiyadi siꞌaiꞌai ma sinumanuma, ma wete sigimwagimwane ma sihehegimwane, ta wete sitanohapaihowa ma sihadahadaꞌabi,
ta ꞌana siga Lota Sodoma ꞌiꞌebesineya, ꞌoinega ꞌaiwe ganinisa ma daꞌule yahiyahidi galewega sigubalama gide dohi, ma tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌiloheꞌamasidiya.
“Ginauledi silatuwa ꞌoidiya, ꞌabwa wete gide tomota ꞌoidiya sida latu ꞌesa, beno tutaina taugu Loheyaiguina yahilama.
“Ma sabweloina ꞌoina ꞌeguma taiya wagahata ꞌimiyamiya, sahena wete hada ꞌalona ꞌiluhuluhu ma ꞌabehega ꞌilotobwatobwa. Wete ꞌeguma taiya tanoha ꞌipaipaihowa sahena ꞌasa weyahina ꞌipilipili.
“Ma hesi wanuwatuhuyahi toꞌaha gide ꞌihapwesa Lota mwanena ꞌoina.
“Ceguma taiya tauna yawasina weyahina ꞌiꞌaipate, nata yawasinaina ꞌiheꞌwadalele, ma ꞌeguma taiya yawasina ꞌitagwale ma ꞌiheꞌwadalele, ꞌabwa ꞌiloba hila.
“Ma yahegwae bwaibwainigomi ꞌabehega hinuwanaina nage ꞌoina tomota ꞌeluwa ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌaigeda ꞌoina siꞌeno, ma ꞌaigeda yatoe ta ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyamiya.
Wete gide wahiwahine ꞌeluwa siꞌeꞌehalo, ꞌaigeda yatoe ta ꞌaigeda ꞌimiyamiya.”
Coinega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sihesilaleya, sigwae, “Bada, taꞌeha?” Ta Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, “Taꞌeha ꞌoina ꞌwayoha ꞌimiyamiya beno ꞌoina ꞌaoꞌao siꞌetoꞌetoꞌauta.”
